audio.speech_model: DeepSpeech 0.1.0 frozen model used by the official extractor
audio.compatibility_change: Removed NumPy deprecated scalar alias only; official audio windows and interpolation retained.

background.method: Official face parser and unchanged step-4 background routine; provided pretrained valid poses used.

changes: Official DeepSpeech neural features replace the previous standalone MFCC features.
The official background algorithm replaces a single-frame background.
Both head and torso checkpoints are placed in the combined renderer directory and required before inference.
Device placement, legacy tensor constructor and deprecated NumPy aliases are adapted for the persistent Ascend runtime.
visual_review: Frames 0, 50 and 100 were opened at native resolution and show changing mouth shapes. Final sampled frames and the 300-frame media metadata were checked. No perceptual-quality or lip-sync benchmark was computed.
scope: Full official 300-frame pretrained reconstruction; no new-person training, novel-speech benchmark or full training-set metric evaluation.

cloud_audio.speech_model: DeepSpeech 0.1.0 frozen model used by the official extractor
cloud_audio.compatibility_change: Removed NumPy deprecated scalar alias only; official audio windows and interpolation retained.

feature_agreement.note: Independent TensorFlow CPU inference on x86/ARM can differ numerically; the rendered input was the full official feature array prepared locally.
